- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested route from Denver to Mount Rushmore includes:
  1. From Denver, take I-25 N towards Cheyenne, WY (approximately 100 miles, 1.5 hours).
  2. Continue on I-25 N to I-90 E towards Rapid City, SD (approximately 270 miles, 4 hours).
  3. Take exit 57 for US-16 E towards Mount Rushmore National Memorial (approximately 25 miles, 30 minutes).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Scenic stops along the way include Cheyenne, WY; Wall, SD; and Badlands National Park, SD.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mount Rushmore National Memorial KOA offers amenities such as a pool, playground, convenience store, laundry facilities, restrooms, Wi-Fi, and a dog park.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recreational activities at the KOA include mini golf, a game room, hiking trails, and a shuttle service to Mount Rushmore.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The KOA offers cabin rentals, including deluxe cabins with full kitchens and private bathrooms.
